title: Boy with Sunglasses & Grandmother, 1954 B&W Snapshot, USA
description: A charming 1954 black and white snapshot featuring a toddler named Cary, aged two and a half, stylishly posing in sunglasses, a short-sleeve printed shirt, shorts, and striped socks. In the background standing near the home's front porch steps is a woman named Sue, likely his grandmother or mother. Taken on June 13, 1954, this photograph offers a sweet glimpse into mid-century American suburban family life.
